category_edits.rationale: Apply label smoothing of 0.02 to masked-item cross-entropy across all four datasets to test whether mild regularization improves ranking. Retain temperature 0.8 and uniform masked-target weighting. Architecture, sampling, optimization and inference remain unchanged; checkpoint and predictor changes are unnecessary.

change_summary: Add 0.02 label smoothing to the existing masked-item loss for each category’s single BERT4Rec model.
